root_idea.summary: A rising, visible flame or blaze, especially the upward tongue of fire, with related extensions to intense heat, brightness, ardor, and forceful motion.
root_idea.development: The root develops from the elevation and brilliance of fire into analogous states of burning heat, thirst, dust raised by rapid movement, and emotional or physical intensity. The mountain-gap term لِهْبٌ is treated as a separate homonymous formation rather than part of this development.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The attested Quranic noun is a standard classical citation form when normalized as لَهَبٌ.

senses.definition: Flame or blaze of fire—the visibly rising, burning manifestation of a fire.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic descriptions of fire, including expressions for a fire possessing flame and for something that does not protect from the flame.

senses.definition: In أَبُو لَهَبٍ, a personal epithet or name associated with flame; in a reported Quranic interpretation, an appellation assigning its bearer to the Fire rather than merely his established kunya.
senses.usage_conditions: Restricted to the proper-name or epithet construction أَبُو لَهَبٍ; the descriptive interpretation is reported as one exegetical explanation, alongside the established use as a kunya.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be thirsty, especially with burning thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb; the thirsty state is presented as a burning or heated condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a fire flame or blaze fiercely or intensely; to cause it to burn without smoke.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II, with an intensive causative force.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a fire flame or blaze, including to make it blaze free from smoke.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative use with fire as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of lightning, to flash continuously or uninterruptedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive use describing repeated or sustained lightning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To run ardently or impetuously, with energy or effort, raising dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a horse or another runner; the dust raised by violent motion is likened to flame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak rapidly and vehemently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV use describing forceful, heated speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For an affair or matter to excite, stir, or inflame someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative causative construction in which the matter acts as the stimulus.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a fire to flame or blaze fiercely or intensely, including without smoke.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V, functioning as the quasi-passive or reflexive counterpart of causative blazing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To burn with intense hunger or to burn with wrath or rage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative Form V uses describing an inwardly heated condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a fire to flame or blaze, including to blaze free from smoke.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII intransitive use with fire as the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become incensed or inflamed with anger against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with عَلَيْهِ, expressing directed anger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a part of the body to become inflamed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive bodily use of Form VIII.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gap, cleft, fissure, or narrow ravine between or in mountains; also a steep mountain face resembling a wall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A homonymous noun with several landscape applications, including a gap or ravine that may widen like a road and a corresponding feature at the horizon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Smoke or dust rising in a visible cloud, especially dust likened to smoke or flame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader non-Quranic application of the noun to airborne dust or smoke, distinct from its Quranic fire-flame use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The heat that reaches or afflicts a thirsty person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A heat-related use of the variant لُهَابٌ, not a claim about the Quranic noun لَهَبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clear white color or the brightness of the complexion or skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use describing visible brightness of appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirst, probably burning thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative heat-related noun for the state of thirst.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intense or smoldering heat: the burning of coals or embers without blazing, heat upon heated ground, vehement heat, or a hot day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A heat noun covering both smoldering combustion and oppressive environmental heat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thirsty or burning with thirst.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a man or woman, with feminine لَهْبَى and plural لِهَابٌ reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The visible manifestation of a fire's burning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun for what appears from the kindling or blazing of fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or cloth containing a stone, used to balance one side of a camel litter or load.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material-culture term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ardor or impetuosity in running; a violent run that raises dust, or the beginning of a run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used both as a noun for the forceful running and as an epithet for a run characterized by raised dust.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Swift or impetuous in running, especially one that raises dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet for a horse or other swift runner; the comparison is to a blazing fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasing in beauty and abundant in hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet explicitly applied to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or piece of cloth imperfectly dyed red and not fully saturated with the dye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material and textile use, marked as figurative in the lexical source.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit contains the core flame meaning, the dust/smoke branch, and a heat phrase corroborated for لُهَابٌ by the independent lexical discussion.
Pointer-only cross-reference to لَهَبٌ and related forms.

cautions: The interpretation of أَبُو لَهَبٍ as a descriptive fire-assignment rather than solely an established kunya is reported as an exegetical alternative, not as an exclusive etymology.

لِهْبٌ meaning a mountain gap is included as a homonymous lexical item because it is directly recorded in the classical evidence, while the root-level evidence separately derives that form from an altered صاد.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The supplied transcription of Lane entry 9902 contains an elided phrase concerning heat. Its attribution to لُهَابٌ is retained only where independently corroborated by the explicit lexical statement that لُهَابٌ denotes heat affecting the thirsty.
